all_reduce_tensors: all reduce a list of tensors across all processes and optionally average by world size
check_master_process: check if the current process is the master process based on GPU rank and num_gpus
get_world_size: get the total number of processes in the distributed world or return 1 if not initialized
init_distributed_training: initialize distributed training process groups per machine using a config with NUM_GPUS and SHARD_ID
review_distributed_helpers: review the distributed helpers module and summarize the all_reduce, is_master_proc, get_world_size, and init_distributed_training functions
